immutable_rules: NEVER move Tier-2 heavy inference or MP4 encoding onto Raspberry Pi 4 (LCK-02).
NEVER change /api/v1/violation_burst HTTP multipart fields ('meta' JSON + 'frames' JPEG list).
NEVER return arbitrary status strings; status MUST be exactly 'SERVER_CNN_CONFIRMED' or 'SERVER_CNN_REJECTED'.
NEVER penalize non_penalty_alert_types (SOS, AUTO_CO2_CRIT, AUTO_CO2_WARN, CO2_CRIT, CO2_WARN, ESP_BROWNOUT).
All inference backends MUST be thread-safe (DeepVerifierEngine runs 2 concurrent worker threads).

input_from_pi_edge.frame_resolution: 800x448 (16:9, rotated 180 deg on Pi before upload)

meta_example.alert_type: DROWSY | YAWNING | DISTRACTED | PHONE | SMOKING | SOS | AUTO_CO2_CRIT | AUTO_CO2_WARN | ESP_BROWNOUT

side_effects_handled_by_server_ai: If SERVER_CNN_CONFIRMED & frames>=2: Server stitches H.264/WebM MP4 (0% Pi CPU)
If SERVER_CNN_CONFIRMED & not in non_penalty_alert_types: Server deducts Trip safety_score once
If SERVER_CNN_REJECTED: Server archives burst + verdict.json to server_ai/data/hard_negatives/ for retraining
Server publishes SSE event 'cnn_verdict' to Fleet Dashboard
